 Katy Perry & Russell Brand’s Divorce Faces Fresh News After the Comedian’s Guilty Verdict
 The former couple divorced in 2012 after two years of marriage. By Allison DeGrushe Plus icon Allison DeGrushe

 Despite their previous marriage, Katy Perry was banned from being mentioned during Russell Brand ’s rape and sexual assault trial.
 According to Deadline , Perry was initially set to be referenced in the prosecution’s opening statements, but her name was omitted after Brand’s attorneys objected. Two of the offenses Brand was found guilty of occurred in 2009, the same year he and Perry began dating, but the disgraced actor’s legal team argued that their relationship was irrelevant to the allegations.
 Related Stories Katy Perry & Justin Trudeau’s 1st Anniversary Plans Revealed After Sources Detail the ‘Huge Test’ Their Relationship Was Put Under Here’s if Justin Trudeau Is ‘Questioning’ Katy Perry After Ruby Rose’s Sexual Assault Claims—’This Is a Huge Test’ 
 “The prosecution recognise that matters post-2009 involving his relationship with Katy Perry may be sensitive, as may his previous faiths, and we are content to remove these from the opening,” lead prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones KC said, per Deadline .
 Brand’s trial began in a London court on Oct. 12, 2026. A little over three weeks later, on November 5, a jury found Brand guilty of rape and sexual assault. He was convicted of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault.
 Related: Meghan Officially Addresses Dad’s ‘Disturbing’ Child Abuse Claims as She Reveals How She ‘Protected’ Archie & Lili from Him—’Deeply Distressed’ 
 Outside of court (per Reuters ), senior Crown prosecutor David Roberts called Brand a “ruthless,” “manipulative,” and “calcuated sexual predator” who used his “growing fame and power to create situations in which he could pursue women sexually, regardless of what they wanted.”
 Judge Joel Bennathan told Brand he would be sentenced to a “significant custodial term,” per the BBC . Judge Bennathan also denied Brand’s bail, and the former actor will remain behind bars until his sentencing on Monday, November 9.
 “You’ve been convicted of a number of offenses, including rape,” Judge Bennathan said. “The consequence of that is inevitably a significant custodial term. My current view is that I therefore have to remand you into custody.”
 The allegations against Brand originally surfaced in 2023 via a joint investigation by The Sunday Times , The Times , and the British TV program Dispatches . Shortly after the accusations came to light, the Metropolitan Police launched an investigation into Brand.
 Brand has vehemently denied the allegations. In a video posted to X in April 2025, he claimed, “I have never engaged in non-consensual activity; I pray you can see that by looking in my eyes.”
 “I was a drug addict, a sex addict, and an imbecile. But what I never was was a rapist,” he said.
